question: Simplify \(\frac{5x+1}{x}-\frac{2x+1}{x}\) (\(x\ne0\)). The result is a constant. What is this constant?
solution: When subtracting fractions with the same denominator, keep the denominator unchanged: \(\frac{5x+1-2x-1}{x}=\frac{3x}{x}=3\).

reference.solution:
Method 1: Subtract the numerators

When subtracting fractions with the same denominator, keep the denominator unchanged: \(\frac{5x+1-2x-1}{x}=\frac{3x}{x}=3\).
